home.about_title: Dalian Medical University at a Glance
home.about_lead: Dalian Medical University is a comprehensive medical institution offering undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programs with a strong focus on clinical practice and research.
home.about_li1: Established legacy in medical education and healthcare training.
home.about_li2: Multi-cultural campus with international students from many countries.
home.about_li3: Collaboration with affiliated hospitals and research centers.
home.news_lead: Stay informed about recent events, announcements and academic highlights from DMU.
home.news_title1: Six disciplines in the global top 1%
home.news_excerpt1: DMU reports six disciplines in the top 1% of ESI global rankings and one national key discipline.
home.news_excerpt2: DMU launched its English-medium MBBS in 2004 through its International Education College, founded in 1985.
home.news_excerpt3: The First Affiliated Hospital has 3,700 authorised beds across four campuses.
home.why_lead: Discover the key advantages that make DMU a preferred destination for medical education.
home.why1_desc: Extensive clinical exposure in well-equipped teaching hospitals and clinics.
home.why2_desc: Diverse student body with learners from many countries around the world.
home.why3_desc: Strong emphasis on research with access to modern labs and projects.
home.why4_desc: Dedicated support services to help international students settle and succeed.
home.how_lead: Follow these simple steps to start your journey at Dalian Medical University.
home.step1: Choose Your Program: Explore MBBS and other programs that match your goals.
home.step2: Check Requirements: Review academic and language requirements for your desired program.
home.step3: Prepare Documents: Collect transcripts, passport copy, medical check-up and other required documents.
home.step4: Submit Application: Apply online or through authorized representatives before the deadline.
home.step5: Receive Offer: On acceptance, complete enrollment and student visa procedures.
home.assistance_desc: Our admissions team is available to guide you at every step of the process, from choosing a program to arriving on campus.

about.history_p1: Dalian Medical University was founded in 1947 as Guandong Medical College and took its present name in 1994. Its International Education College, founded in 1985, launched the English-medium MBBS in 2004.
about.history_li1: 1947: founded in Dalian as Guandong Medical College.
about.history_li3: 2007: moved to the Lvshunkou campus, where the university is today.
about.leadership_p1: Information about the university's leadership and faculty is published by the university on its English website, english.dmu.edu.cn.
about.leadership_li1: See english.dmu.edu.cn for the university's own leadership pages.
about.vision_p1: Dalian Medical University trains students in medicine, dentistry, pharmacy and related fields on a campus of 1,510,000 square metres in Lvshunkou District, Dalian.
about.vision_li1: Six disciplines in the top 1% of ESI global rankings, according to DMU.
about.vision_li2: Three directly affiliated hospitals and 14 affiliated hospitals in total.
about.vision_li3: More than 1,200 international students from over 100 countries.

scholarships.lead_desc: Explore various scholarship opportunities to support your education.
scholarships.available_desc: Dalian Medical University offers a variety of scholarships to assist students in achieving their educational goals. These scholarships are designed to recognize academic excellence, financial need, and other achievements.
scholarships.step1: Check the eligibility criteria for the scholarship you wish to apply for.
scholarships.step2: Prepare the necessary documents, including transcripts, recommendation letters, and personal statements.
scholarships.step3: Submit your application through the official university portal or relevant authority.

partner.page_title: Why partner with Dalian Medical University
partner.p1: Our Partner Program is designed for professional consultants and education organizations who want to support students in starting their medical education journey in China with confidence.
partner.p2: By joining our partner network, you receive structured guidance, regular updates, and a responsive admissions support team. We focus on transparent communication, reliable documentation flow, and student-centered outcomes.
partner.p3: Partners can work with us to explore suitable courses, evaluate applicant profiles, and streamline submissions through a practical collaboration framework aligned with Dalian Medical University standards.
partner.highlight1: Structured admissions guidance from inquiry to enrollment
partner.highlight3: Fast response support for consultants and institutions
partner.program_p1: Our mission is to offer a reliable process that helps your team guide students with clarity and professionalism. We provide up-to-date admission requirements, timelines, and program details so your counseling team can operate with confidence.
partner.program_p2: With consistent support and transparent procedures, your organization can improve conversion quality, reduce uncertainty, and deliver a better experience to every applicant.
partner.program_h2: Regular updates on policy and application requirements
partner.program_h3: Practical communication channel with admissions support
partner.program_h4: Long-term partnership model for sustainable growth
partner.wave_title: Still having questions about our partnership programs?
partner.wave_desc: Have questions about the collaboration process? Reach out and our team will guide you through the details and onboarding steps.
